mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_table (user_idx, area_code, title, start_date, end_date, status) VALUES (#{user_idx}, #{area_code}, #{title}, #{start_date}, #{end_date}, #{status});
INSERT INTO date_table (plan_idx, date, memo) VALUES (#{plan_idx}, #{date}, '');

INSERT INTO place_table (date_idx, visit_order, content_id, content_type_id, title, thumbnail, map_x, map_y, time) VALUES (#{date_idx}, #{visit_order}, #{content_id}, #{content_type_id}, #{title}, #{thumbnail}, #{map_x}, #{map_y}, #{time});
mapper.select: SELECT p.idx as plan_idx, p.user_idx, p.area_code, p.title, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.status, d.idx as date_idx, d.date, d.memo, pt.place_idx, pt.visit_order, pt.content_id, pt.content_type_id, pt.title as place_title, pt.thumbnail, pt.map_x, pt.map_y, pt.time FROM plan_table p LEFT JOIN date_table d ON p.idx = d.plan_idx LEFT JOIN place_table pt ON d.idx = pt.date_idx WHERE p.idx = #{planId} ORDER BY d.date ASC, pt.visit_order ASC
